parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment explicitly suggests an action: comparing the resource cost of the MSLR approach to directly tuning a late-fusion model with separate learning rates for each modality. It names the alternative approach and mentions a compute-budget condition, but it does not provide concrete details on how the comparison should be carried out. The authors can identify the modification needed - adding an experiment comparing the two methods - but the comment leaves open how to implement it, such as the tuning procedure, baselines, or evaluation metrics. Thus the action is explicit but vague on execution, so it falls at the level where an action is clearly stated but lacks implementation detail.
